groupDescriptions.mirostat: Adaptive perplexity-targeting sampler. Overrides Top K / Top P / Min P.
groupDescriptions.dry: Don't-Repeat-Yourself penalty for long repeated sequences.
groupDescriptions.xtc: Exclude-Top-Choices sampler — probabilistically removes high-prob tokens.
groupDescriptions.dynatemp: Sample the effective temperature from a range around the base.

paramDescriptions.max_context_tokens: Total token budget (input + output). Older messages are trimmed/compacted to stay within this. 0 disables trimming.
paramDescriptions.max_output_tokens: Maximum tokens the model may generate in one reply. Sent as max_tokens to OpenAI-compatible APIs.
paramDescriptions.auto_compact: When context limit is reached, summarize older messages instead of dropping them. Requires Max Context Tokens to be set.
paramDescriptions.top_p: Nucleus sampling threshold. Higher values allow more diverse word choices.
paramDescriptions.top_k: Sample from the top K most likely tokens. 0 = disabled.
paramDescriptions.min_p: Minimum relative probability for a token to be considered.
paramDescriptions.frequency_penalty: Reduces word repetition based on prior frequency.
paramDescriptions.presence_penalty: Encourages the model to introduce new topics.
paramDescriptions.repeat_penalty: llama.cpp-style multiplicative penalty for repeated tokens. 1.0 = disabled.
paramDescriptions.grammar: GBNF grammar to constrain generations. Ignored while tools are enabled, and takes precedence over JSON Schema.
paramDescriptions.json_schema: JSON schema constraining the output to valid JSON. Ignored if a grammar is also set.
paramDescriptions.top_n_sigma: Filter by standard deviations above the max logit. -1 = off.
paramDescriptions.dynatemp_range: Effective temperature is sampled in [temperature - range, temperature + range]. 0 = off.
paramDescriptions.dynatemp_exp: Shapes the temperature distribution within the range.
paramDescriptions.xtc_probability: Probability of activating the Exclude-Top-Choices sampler.
paramDescriptions.xtc_threshold: Minimum token probability to be eligible for XTC exclusion.
paramDescriptions.dry_allowed_length: Minimum repeated-sequence length before DRY engages.
paramDescriptions.repeat_last_n: Number of recent tokens considered for the repeat penalty. 0 = disabled.
paramDescriptions.samplers: Order in which samplers are applied, comma-separated (e.g. "top_k,typ_p,top_p,min_p,xtc,temperature"). Empty = server default order.
paramDescriptions.backend_sampling: Use the model backend's own sampler instead of llama.cpp's.
paramDescriptions.thinking_budget_tokens: Maximum tokens the model may spend on reasoning before being forced to answer. -1 = unlimited.

paramHints.mirostat: When enabled, overrides Top K / Top P / Min P.
